newsitem.title: VENEZUELA: Venezuela bolivar closes little changed.
newsitem.headline: Venezuela bolivar closes little changed.

text.p: The Venezuelan bolivar closed flat in quiet trade for the second day running on Tuesday at 476/477 per dollar while traders said they anticipated a rise in interest rates at Wednesday's regular auction of Central Bank TEMs.
"None of the banks are short dollars, and with a small rise in rates everything looks quiet for tomorrow," said one trader.
Brokers said mostly balanced trade Monday had been nudged throughout the day by modest Central Bank dollar sales.
